room_description: A creepy, abandoned underground hospital room or bunker. It features a rusty bed with a body bag, a medical monitor, an ultrasound machine, and blood stains on the floor.

key_moments.description: Establishing shot of the dark medical room.
Inspects a combination safe hidden in a floor panel.
Enters the code '5985' to unlock the floor safe.
Retrieves a CD/DVD from the opened floor safe.
Inserts the CD into the laptop resting on the bed.
Completes a sliding photo puzzle on the laptop screen.
Checks the newly activated medical monitor on the wall.
Checks the toe tag on the body bag, reading the number '240'.
Turns a red valve on a wall pipe until the pressure gauge hits 240.
Collects a small key that drops from the pressurized pipe.

solution_steps: Determine the 4-digit code (likely deciphered from the ultrasound machine imagery).
Enter '5985' into the combination lock on the floor.
Insert the CD into the laptop to trigger the puzzle.
Slide the scrambled tiles to form a complete vintage photograph of a group of people.
Completing the photo powers on the wall-mounted medical monitor.
Find the toe tag on the body bag to get the target number '240'.
Locate the pipe and turn the red valve to increase the pressure.
Stop exactly when the gauge needle hits 240.
puzzles.reward: A small key drops from the pipe

final_action: Uses the small key dropped from the pipe to unlock the padlock securing the chains on the main exit doors.
